environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with identical API Gateway configuration (Cognito User Pool authorizer). The Lambda execution role policy includes a dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition that restricts item-level access. However, the condition uses a session tag propagated from the Cognito identity pool federated credentials flow (not directly from the authorizer claims). The role trust policy requires sts:TagSession with a principal tag 'user_sub' set during AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity. The DynamoDB policy condition uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys with ${aws:PrincipalTag/user_sub} which binds the partition key access to the authenticated caller's Cognito sub. Note: the Lambda uses an enhanced Cognito Identity Pool integration where each invocation assumes a scoped role via STS, not the default Lambda execution role.

config.lambda_execution_model: Per-request STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity via Cognito Identity Pool enhanced auth flow
config.session_tag_mapping: Cognito sub claim -> aws:PrincipalTag/user_sub (configured in Identity Pool attribute mapping)
